emailIntake.title: Email intake
emailIntake.description: Forward court and registry emails to your private address and CauseDeck reads them for you.
emailIntake.notEnabledReason: This is not enabled yet for this workspace.
emailIntake.offlineReason: Settings can be changed when you are back online.

channel.title: Email forwarding
channel.disclosure: Forwarded emails are processed in India. Forward only what you want CauseDeck to read. Client emails are excluded unless you choose to forward them.

address.title: Your intake address
address.description: Forward emails here. Only you and the workspace admins can see this address. Anyone who knows it can send to it, so keep it private.
address.label: Intake address
address.empty: You do not have an intake address yet.
address.rotateBody: A new address is created and the current one stops working at once. Emails sent to the old address will not arrive.
address.revokeBody: The address stops working at once and you will have no intake address until you create a new one.

allowlist.title: Allowed senders
allowlist.description: Emails from these senders are accepted. Add the courts, e-filing portals and counsel you expect to forward from.
allowlist.label: Label (optional)

aims.title: Set up AIMS cause-list emails
aims.description: Have your AIMS account email the daily cause list to your intake address.
aims.step2: In your AIMS account, add it as an email recipient for cause-list notifications.
aims.step3: Add the AIMS sender domain under Allowed senders as a court.
aims.note: CauseDeck only reads emails from senders on your list.

toast.rotated: Address rotated. The old one no longer works.
toast.error: Could not change it. Nothing was changed.
toast.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
toast.invalid: Check the email or domain and try again.
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
